title: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. translated_title: 学习与遗忘并行：面向持续学习与机器遗忘同时实现的突触角色划分
translated_abstract: 持续学习（CL）要求模型在不遗忘已有知识的前提下获取新知识。机器遗忘（MU）则要求模型在不损害其余知识的情况下销毁特定知识。挑战在于将二者集成到同一系统中：这两个目标作用于相同的权重，为其中一个目标所做的修改会损害另一个目标。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Learning with Unlearning（LwU），这是一个在冲突发生的源头——即单个突触层面——化解冲突的统一框架。LwU对每个权重进行两次评分，一次针对要保留的数据，一次针对要删除的数据，并将网络划分为四个具有独立更新规则的区域。仅需保留的权重被冻结；仅需删除的权重被清除并作为自由容量返还给网络；存在冲突的权重则沿与保留梯度正交的方向进行梯度上升更新；剩余容量则通过特权……学习新任务（原文摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了统一框架LwU，通过在突触层面对每个权重进行“保留”与“删除”双重评分，将网络划分为四个具有独立更新规则的区域，从而在同一模型中同时化解持续学习与机器遗忘之间的冲突。
en_tdlr: LwU is a unified framework that resolves the conflict between continual learning and machine unlearning at the individual synapse level, scoring each weight against both retention and deletion data to partition the network into four zones with distinct update rules.
